speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: I map the flight from London as civilization breaks into a human torrent.

text: The Martians spread vapour across roads, bridges, railways, and homes.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: At the Pool, escape becomes fighting among jammed boats and desperate people.

text: An hour later, wreckage floats above Limehouse.

text: George leads the two women east, carrying the last plan for escape.

text: He hears of cylinders falling beyond the hills and keeps watch.

text: At Tillingham, hunger searches every cottage and property loses its meaning.

text: Then the sea opens, carrying a fleet large enough to promise escape.

text: I would rather die than trust myself friendless in a foreign country.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: George answers her panic with both arms raised toward the steamer.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Thirty-six pounds buys the three fugitives a place on the water.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: The captain counts the fare, and the boat brings them passage.

text: George pays at the gangway, then puts the women aboard.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: As the decks fill, guns speak southward and three ironclads appear.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Three Martians wade toward the refugee fleet, closing the open route.

text: The steamer swings, George falls, and Thunder Child tears between them.

text: The ironclad drives straight at the Martians, carrying the fleet's hope.

text: Gas, Heat-Ray, steam, and naval fire turn the water into a battlefield.

text: The cheers fade behind us as the fleet scatters into evening haze.
